There have been a few eroge that I have purchased and wasn't expecting too much from. I was just curious if anyone else has had that pleasant surprise.
What are some eroge that surprised and surpassed your expectations?

For me there are 2 that stick out in my mind.

The first was The Sagara Family. I received it as part of a grab bag from Jlist. I wasn't expecting much at all from the title. The art looked nice, but I expected a pretty basic experience. I was taken by surprise by the multiple animated scenes and the volume of scenes the eroge contained. The animation and artwork were very well done. The voice acting was spot on too. I would recommend this game for anyone who hasn't tried it.

The second was Pretty Soldier War A.D. 2048. The animation and voice acting are decent. What surprised me was the combat. It may have been because I was expecting something really horrid when it came to the strategy portions of the game. I'll admit it wasn't the most in-depth tactical strategy game I have ever played, but it was enjoyable.

I'd like to see some beginners try their hand at this, so I'm posting a few videos.

The basic concept is simple - draw triangles over source material to create a low polygon version. If your software uses the Delaunay triangulation method, then the triangle should be a combination of the colors that it masks. This makes the art look less flat (i.e. like a matte color) and more like a gradient of shades.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FRsA5l-GNuI or http://www.photosincolor.com/artist-creates-iphone-selfie-using-over-1000-triangles/ or https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSAGUhzA-90
